_help: Login-screen banner for Lite and the free trial. enabled:false hides it everywhere. Each item: id, url ({lang} = viewer's language), optional enabled:false, optional text {lang: sentence}. Ids bellopos/market/bellosend/pro already have translations in every app language; text you add overrides them for that language. A new id needs at least an 'en' text. show_on_trial:false hides it during the trial. rotate_seconds = how long each slogan stays after it flashes, before the next slides in. Tills re-read this file every 3 hours.
